purpose: Lunatic Nights 조작 안내 디자인 비교용 정지 이미지

concepts.name: 붉은 달의 전투 교본
concepts.prompt:
Use case: high-fidelity game UI concept. Create ONE landscape 16:9 imagined full-screen screenshot of the original Lunatic Nights game Controls Guide. Reference image 1 is the existing title screen. Its engraved graphic novel ink, vermilion blood moon, dark iron, charred stone, tattered crimson cloth, aging bronze, and muted ivory type define the new bespoke menu art. Reference image 2 is the current Controls Guide screenshot and MUST be used as evidence for the actual game preview canvas: match the side-scrolling pixel-art visuals inside its left viewport (same Barel sprite, scale, stage, pixel texture and corner HUD). Replace the old guide chrome entirely with original illustrations and a strong composition. In every concept an unmistakable large rectangular live in-game skill demo with actual sprite-scale hero and discrete pixel art is mandatory, at least 52% of total screen width; the selected skill's real visible performance, keycap, name and one-line description must be immediately paired and simultaneously visible in that same screen. The preview is a diegetic screen design, but the scene INSIDE it is in-engine 2D pixel game footage, not a painted hero portrait, full-screen splash art, diagram, engraving in a book, or cinematic illustration. Do not play any other skill than the one selected. Show large, clean, readable Korean labels and exact key legends, no other gibberish, preserve contrast and open space around the UI. One complete full bleed screenshot, no monitors or presentation canvas, no fake gradients on broad modern cards, no browser widgets, no watermark. Main heading text exactly "조작 안내". Bottom primary action text exactly "직접 연습". Small secondary action "돌아가기".
Big left 65%-width live screenshot centered on the moment Barel strikes a nearby ordinary enemy with a bright white and ember-red horizontal pixel sword arc. Use an architectural black iron frame with gothic arch silhouettes around the video, not over it. Title above the scene. Right control index snug at the same height on a clean recessed bronze surface, four rows with engraved keycaps "X 점프", "Z 공격 3연타" (this row unmistakably selected red), "Shift 대시", "C 흑월참". Selected skill details directly under the preview say "공격 3연타" then "Z → Z → Z" then "연속으로 눌러 3연속 베기". Subtle live demo playback timeline. The vermilion moon looks in from behind the frame through a side buttress of the fictional menu. High readability, title-menu-compatible.
